streamVerification.notShared: Stream was verified locally, but the player couldn't reach the verification service.
streamVerification.explanation:
the player may sometimes play the wrong version of a song. To fix it, right-click the queue item and pick the right stream, then click Verify. the player saves your verification on your computer and always plays that stream for the track.

If Online verification is on, the player also shares your verification with other users, so they get that stream first. For each track you didn't verify, the player asks the verification service for the stream with the most votes. It sends the artist, the title, and a random ID.
